fling_config.enabled.description: Enable fling service configuration (required to render template)

fling_config.instances[].name.description: Human-readable name for this instance (for documentation only)

fling_config.instances[].host.description: Remote hostname or IP address (required for 'sender' and 'ssh_auto' modes)

fling_config.instances[].port.description: TCP port to use (required for 'sender' and 'receiver' modes); 0 = auto-select in some contexts but not recommended

fling_config.instances[].output_path.description: Remote file path to receive data (for 'ssh_auto' mode)

fling_config.instances[].output_file.description: Local file path to write received data (for 'receiver' mode)

fling_config.instances[].remote_exe.description: Override remote fling executable path (env var: FLING_REMOTE_EXE)

fling_config.instances[].verbose.description: Enable verbose output (env var: FLING_VERBOSE=1 when true)

fling_config.instances[].progress.description: Enable progress reporting (env var: FLING_PROGRESS=1 when true)
